The Field Service Technician is responsible for carrying out services and maintenance at Customer Installations and where applicable as well for assembly and dismantling. 

Will maintain, repair and perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of Air Liquide installations (PG,Cryo, bulk & On Sites) and equipment at customer sites within the assigned budget. 

He/She executes the maintenance work according to procedures and standards. After each work execution, the technician manages his intervention report signed by the customers and communicates with the Maintenance Planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 

Provide On-site support for testing, and troubleshooting. 

He/she provides a high level of quality of service to customers in the assigned area and ensures legal and IMS compliance. 

He/she implements the environmental legislation, works in line with the ISO 14001 standard, , respects the good environmental practices and shows a positive attitude with regard to the preservation of the environment 

 

Performs preventive & corrective maintenance
 
 

• Executes preventive maintenance according to planning, with sub-contractor if required. 

• Performs the all kind of maintenance work on PG, Bulk & On Sites according procedure and standard 

• Contact the maintenance planners if corrective maintenance is required. 

• Prepares reports and obtains the customer signature on maintenance intervention report. 

• Confirms data in SAP (kilometers-time-spare parts used-cause of failure...)  

 
 

Repairs and troubleshooting of equipment failures
 
 

• The FST will execute the intervention once the work is confirmed by the maintenance planner and spare parts are available. 

• Will analyzes and identifies malfunctions as well determines the necessary repairs, and carries them out (with subcontractor if applicable). 

• Will communicate the spare parts used and obtain the intervention report signed by the customer.  

 
 

Ensures all quality & safety procedures are followed
 
 

• Understands and adheres to all relevant IMS procedures within the scope of their qualifications 

• Ensures Compliances and applies IMS and legal rules. 

• Knows and respects the country SOPs and standards 

•    

Reports accurate and up-to-date maintenance information
 
 

• Communicates with the Maintenance planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 

• Confirms completion of work after site visit 

• Writes consolidated reports on quality defects and customer complaints  

 
 

Communicates potential problems that may affect safety, reliability & quality
 
 

• Identifies through experience and troubleshooting analysis the dysfunctionment of gas equipments 

• Observes work area(s) and is alert to and avoids unsafe behaviors and conditions or other hazards 

• Participates in corrective measures when appropriate or authorized  

 
 

Face to face with the customers & internal sales force
 
 

• Communicates professionally and respectfully with customers. 

• Supports the project team with assembly and dismantling if applicable, as well as new or retrofit PG, Bulk, on Site, cryo or MGPS projects. 

• Respects and promotes the Zero safety incident goal 

• Ensure operational readiness of service vehicles, PPE, tools, and work equipment. 

• Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of normal business hours 

Experience
 
 

• Good troubleshooting skills 

• Good understanding of operations & safety procedures 

• Capable to analyse trends, problems & cause-effects 

• Understanding of procedures and regulatory for new and existing industrial installations 

• Good knowledge maintenance activities 

• Technical understanding of gas physical and production processes 

• Good understanding of Safety procedures  

 
 

Competencies:
 

Hard skills:
 
 

• Language proficiency 

• Fluent in Dutch 

• Pre-intermediate English 

• Maintenance tools & methods (SAP) 

• IMS 

• Google tools 

• Telemetry applications 

• Mechanical and /or electrical and / or automation knowledge  

Soft skills : 
 
 

• Promoting and supporting actions towards Safety, Health and environment protection 

• Encourages questioning of established ideas and practices and ask why regularly and provide deliverables on time 

• Good communication with the different stakeholders 

• Customer mindset & team player 

• Team player 

• Striving for continuous improvement

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
